name: forward_to_nested_routine
description: Calls one nested routine and returns straight away, with no data access of its own.

name: store_conditional_table_entry
description: Sets a shared flag, makes three nested calls, then calls a routine and checks a byte it points to. Only when that byte is 1 or 2 does it store the result and a companion value into a table indexed by the low five bits of the argument.

name: store_table_entry_after_calls
description: Makes three nested calls, then for a non-negative argument calls a routine and checks a byte through a pointer. When the byte is 1 or 2 it stores the result plus sixteen and a companion value into a table indexed by the low bits of the argument.

name: store_table_entry_if_match
description: Calls a nested routine and, when a byte it points to is 1 or 2, stores its result plus sixteen and a companion value into a table selected by the low five bits of a register argument. Otherwise it returns without storing.

name: setup_quotient_state_with_flag
description: Sets a shared flag, calls a routine that returns a value, and reads a flag byte. It then stores the value plus six and a shifted copy of the argument, and derives two quotients by dividing that shifted value by counts from the argument, skipping a division whose divisor is zero.

name: setup_quotient_state_from_call
description: Calls a routine for a value and checks a flag byte, calling five routines and returning when it is not 0 or 3. Otherwise it stores the value plus six and divides a shifted copy of the argument by two derived counts, skipping any zero divisor, then sets a shared flag to one.

name: setup_quotient_state_from_register
description: Stores the register argument plus six, then performs the same shifted-value division sequence as its siblings, with a sign-dependent call at the end. It makes no early exit based on a flag byte.

name: call_then_set_flag_on
description: Calls a nested routine and then sets a shared flag byte to one. It has no other logic.

name: call_five_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls the same nested routine five times in succession and returns, with no other work visible in the code.

name: copy_register_via_subroutine
description: Calls a one-instruction subroutine that copies one register into another, then returns. The routine does nothing beyond that call.

name: dispatch_indirect_table_call
description: Reads a byte through an address register and uses it as an index into a table of 16-bit offsets, then calls the routine at the computed location. The jump table was not recovered, so only the dispatch form is certain.

name: swap_state_then_dispatch
description: Exchanges two 32-bit state words, then performs the same table-indexed indirect call as its neighbouring dispatcher. The jump table was not recovered.

name: forward_call_result_chain
description: Calls a routine that returns a value, passes that value to a second routine, and then calls a third routine. The listing shows only this sequence of nested calls.

name: init_region_table_entries
description: Clears a status word, sets a width of 319 and a height of 199 in a state block, and writes several fixed offsets and a flag byte. It then fills a table, stepping a counter by 34 and skipping zero steps, until the table pointer reaches its bound.

name: copy_name_and_init_offsets
description: When a global flag is set, copies a zero-terminated name into a buffer and replaces the character after its last dot with an uppercase C. It then branches on a selector word and, on the longer path, derives several table offsets from state words, stores them and calls subroutines.

name: decode_run_length_byte_stream
description: Loops without returning, reading bytes from a source. A byte with its top bit clear gives a repeat count for a pair of routine calls, while a byte with the top bit set gives a count for a single call. The starting step is one, or eight when a global flag holds minus sixty-four.

name: read_byte_with_refill
description: Returns the byte at a buffer pointer. When the pointer has reached its limit it first calls a subroutine to refill the buffer and moves the pointer to the new buffer start.

name: write_byte_at_offset_guarded
description: Writes the low byte of the data register through a window pointer, first recomputing that pointer from a stored base when it has reached its limit. It skips the write when the offset word is zero.

name: compact_and_rebase_records
description: When a key word matches a stored entry, it looks up a position and shifts a block of words down by the gap to the next stored value, then reduces a count. It then adjusts stored offsets and 24-bit chain pointers that lie beyond the moved position.

name: shift_block_and_adjust_offsets
description: Copies words from a source to a destination up to the end of a stored block, shrinks the block counter, and adjusts stored offsets and 24-bit chain pointers that lie past the moved position. It is the same block-shift operation as its neighbour without the leading key check.

name: rebase_entry_chains_by_gap
description: Walks a linked list of entries, calling a routine for entries whose key word matches and otherwise lowering stored offsets above a threshold by a gap value. Once the list ends it applies the same 24-bit pointer adjustment to a second chain.

name: walk_and_rebase_entry_list
description: Walks a list of entries, calling a routine for entries whose key word matches and otherwise lowering stored offsets above a threshold by a gap value. It then adjusts the 24-bit link pointers in the attached chain by the same gap.

name: adjust_subchain_pointers_by_gap
description: Walks a list of entries and, for each one, walks its sub-chain lowering the 24-bit link pointers that lie past a threshold by a gap value. It makes no other changes.

name: adjust_chain_pointers_from_list
description: Walks a list of entries and, for each one, walks its sub-chain lowering 24-bit link pointers that lie past a threshold by a gap value. It returns its argument unchanged.

name: forward_call_preserving_registers
description: Calls a nested routine and returns the two register values it was given without modification. It has no other logic.

name: binary_search_word_table
description: Binary-searches a table of pointers to 16-bit keys for the value in the data register and returns as soon as it finds a match. Nothing is returned if the value is absent.

name: initialize_offset_list_entries
description: Fills a region with entries, writing an offset that grows by six at each step and a zero beside it until the bound is reached. It then clears one slot and sets two state words to one and six.

name: insert_sorted_entry_record
description: Rounds a requested size up to even, advances an allocation pointer by it, and inserts the new pointer into a sorted array by linear scan, shifting later entries. When the table is full it returns; otherwise it clears the new record and fills in its links and flags.

name: remove_entry_and_service_queue
description: When the record is new it sets up its fields and returns. Otherwise it removes a matching entry from a linked list, lowers later offsets by the gap, then loops over the remaining entries, decrementing countdown bytes and calling routines when a countdown expires.

name: unlink_entry_and_run_countdowns
description: Removes the entry in the data register from a linked list and lowers later offsets by the gap. When the removed entry is the one being serviced, it loops over the remaining entries, decrementing countdown bytes and calling routines when one reaches zero.

name: read_value_until_flag_clears
description: Checks flag bits in the data register and reads a value through a nested routine when the relevant bit is set. It returns the value once it is non-negative and bit ten is clear, and otherwise calls a routine and reads again.

name: call_and_return_input_value
description: Calls a nested routine and then returns the data register value it was given, unchanged. It has no other logic.

name: retry_read_until_nonnegative
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until it returns a non-negative value, calling a second routine between attempts. It returns the value from the most recent second call.

name: retry_read_store_status
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until it returns a non-negative status, storing that status in a shared variable. It calls a second routine between attempts and returns the value from the most recent second call.

name: poll_until_nonnegative_result
description: Repeatedly calls a routine and, while its result is negative, calls another routine before trying again. It returns once the first result is non-negative.

name: poll_status_into_shared_variable
description: Repeatedly calls a routine, copying each result into a shared variable, and calls a second routine while the result is negative. It returns the value from the most recent second call.

name: repeat_pair_until_nonnegative
description: Calls one routine and then a second routine on each pass, repeating while the second result is negative. It returns once that result is non-negative and returns no value.

name: retry_dispatch_until_success
description: Calls a nested routine with the saved register values until its result is non-negative. Between attempts it calls a second routine and carries forward its address-register results, returning the last value.

name: retry_read_keep_last_value
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until its result is non-negative, and between attempts calls another routine whose result becomes the value returned.

name: repeat_pair_return_first
description: Calls two routines on each pass and repeats while the second result is negative. It returns the first routine's value from the final pass.

name: step_countdown_state_flags
description: Calls a routine and steps a countdown byte held in a shared variable, calling further routines according to its sign and zero state. When a second countdown and a pointer-held flag are set it calls more routines, and it clears the shared variable before returning.

name: clear_flags_and_call_conditionals
description: Calls a routine and clears a shared variable, then calls routines conditionally on the sign and zero state of that variable and of a second byte. It clears the variable again before returning.

name: advance_counted_accumulator
description: Decrements a record's counter and, while it is nonzero and the sum stays non-negative, adds a step into an accumulator clamped at 32767 and calls a routine. Otherwise it clears the record's accumulator, step and flag bytes and calls a routine.

name: clear_record_and_call
description: Clears an accumulator word, a second word and three flag bytes in a record, then calls a routine.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four nested routines one after another and returns. It has no other logic.

name: clear_record_state_fields
description: Zeroes one byte, two further bytes and two words of a record pointed to by the address register, then returns.

name: advance_clamped_step_counters
description: Updates an accumulator from a step value, clamping it at 32767, while decrementing one of several counters. It calls routines on either path and clears a flag when a sequence ends.

name: accumulate_clamped_step_and_call
description: Adds a step to an accumulator, applies a stored limit and clamps the result at 32767. It then decrements a counter and calls two routines.

name: decrement_counter_and_call_twice
description: Decrements a counter word and calls two nested routines in sequence. It has no other logic.

name: call_then_clear_shared_flag
description: Calls a nested routine and then clears a shared variable to zero. It has no other logic.

name: return_to_caller
description: Contains only a return instruction, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It does no work.

name: pick_largest_byte_and_store
description: When the shared byte is zero, it scans several byte-sized candidates for the largest value and, if the shared byte is not below it, writes that byte after the selected location. It then calls a routine.

name: pick_largest_byte_guarded_store
description: When the shared byte is zero, it compares it with another byte-sized value to find the largest, and if the shared byte is not below that largest it writes the shared byte into the location after the selected one. It then calls a routine.

name: pick_largest_byte_with_bound
description: When the shared byte is zero, it compares it with two further byte-sized values to find the largest, and if the shared byte is not below that largest it writes the shared byte into the location after the selected one. It then calls a routine.

name: pick_largest_byte_long_path
description: When the shared byte is zero, it compares it with several byte-sized values and stores the shared byte after the selected location. The recovered listing shows only the opening of this long routine, so its later behaviour is not certain.

name: pick_largest_byte_wide_candidates
description: When the shared byte is zero, it compares it with a wider set of byte-sized values to find the largest, and stores the shared byte after the selected location if it is not below that largest. It then calls a routine.

name: pick_largest_byte_extended_candidates
description: When the shared byte is zero, it compares it against an extended set of byte-sized values and stores the shared byte after the selected location if it is not below the largest. The recovered listing shows only the opening of the routine.

name: pick_largest_byte_then_call
description: When the shared byte is zero, it compares it with several byte-sized values and stores the shared byte after the selected location when it is not below the largest. It then calls three nested routines.

name: start_audio_channel_playback
description: Calls a system library routine through a library base, then programs an audio channel's pointer, length, period and volume from its arguments, capping the volume at 100 and computing a per-channel mask. It finishes by calling a second library routine with the channel block.

name: clear_channel_flag_if_negative
description: When a channel's flag byte is negative, it clears that flag and a byte reached through a pointer, then computes a channel bit mask shifted left by seven into a shared variable. Otherwise it does nothing.

name: service_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Tests four bits of a shared word and calls a routine for each one that is set, then stores a fixed constant into that word. The recovered facts show it touches interrupt request and enable registers.

name: decrement_channel_counter
description: Decrements a per-channel word counter reached through a pointer. When the counter reaches zero it clears a byte through another pointer and the channel's flag byte, then computes a channel bit mask shifted left by seven into a shared variable.

name: call_four_handlers_sequentially
description: Calls four nested routines one after another and returns. It has no other logic.

name: call_and_return_register_pair
description: Calls a nested routine and returns the two register values it was given, unchanged. It has no other logic.

name: call_and_return_data_register
description: Calls a nested routine and then returns the data register value it was given, unchanged. It has no other logic.

name: forward_registers_to_nested_call
description: Passes its register arguments to a nested routine and returns the register pair, unchanged. It has no other logic.

name: store_masked_index_shifted
description: Stores the low seven bits of the data register, shifted left by three, into a shared state word. It has no other effect.

name: forward_call_keep_data_value
description: Calls a nested routine and returns the data register value it was given, unchanged. It has no other logic.

name: store_clamped_audio_volume
description: Caps a value at 100 and, when it is non-negative, stores it to a shared variable and to the volume registers of the first three audio channels. A negative value is only stored to the shared variable.

name: store_word_in_record_field
description: Stores the data register word into a field 216 bytes past the structure reached through the address register. It has no other effect.

name: configure_audio_channel_three
description: Programs audio channel three's pointer, period and volume from its arguments, using a halved and capped volume value and recording the channel state. It then writes control words to the DMA and interrupt registers, with the interrupt setting depending on the sign of an argument.

name: init_channel_control_fields
description: Writes the value 1024 and a DMA control constant into two fields of a structure reached through the address register.

name: setup_audio_interrupt_state
description: Saves four register arguments into shared variables, calls a library routine through a function pointer, and clears a block of shared bytes. It then conditionally stores an interrupt-related pointer, sets bits in a control byte of a structure, and calls a final routine through a pointer.

name: update_timer_countdown_state
description: When a shared counter is nonzero, it either stops the countdown and restores a saved value when the argument is zero, or otherwise reconfigures the control state and clears a bit in a control byte of a structure. It writes fixed control constants on each path.

name: update_countdown_state_by_sign
description: Chooses one of three countdown configurations from the sign and zero state of its argument. A negative value writes one set of control constants, zero stops the countdown and restores a saved value, and a positive value writes another set and clears a bit in a control byte of a structure.

name: set_registers_and_reload_value
description: Writes two constant control values and zero to shared variables, then reloads a shared variable from a saved value when it is zero. It makes no calls.

name: clear_flags_and_reload_value
description: Clears two shared variables and masks a third, clears one bit in a control byte of a structure, and writes two constants. It then reloads a shared variable from a saved value when it is zero.

name: conditionally_set_control_bits
description: If one shared byte is non-zero, it stores a handler pointer into a shared variable and writes two constant words. If another shared byte is non-zero, it sets bit 0 of a control byte in a structure and ORs nine into a shared variable.

name: dispatch_flagged_handler_by_bit
description: When a high flag bit is set, it tests four bits of a shared word in turn and calls the handler pointer for the first one that is set, returning its result. The indirect jump targets were not recovered, so they are not named.

name: dispatch_three_handler_bits
description: Tests three bits of its data register argument in turn and calls the handler pointer for the first one that is set, returning its result. The indirect jump targets were not recovered.

name: dispatch_two_handler_bits
description: Tests two bits of its data register argument in turn and calls the handler pointer for the first one that is set, returning its result. The indirect jump targets were not recovered.

name: dispatch_single_handler_bit
description: Tests one bit of its data register argument and, if it is set, calls the matching handler pointer and returns its result. Otherwise it returns the argument unchanged. The indirect jump target was not recovered.

name: dispatch_masked_handler_bits
description: Combines two state words with a mask and, for the first of four bits set in the result, calls the matching handler pointer and returns its result. The indirect jump targets were not recovered.

name: initialize_handler_control_block
description: Sets two shared variables to fixed control values, then writes a handler pointer and a saved word into two fields of a structure reached through the address register, clearing the saved word. It then stores a handler pointer in a control block.

name: initialize_handler_control_block
description: Sets two shared variables to fixed control values, then writes a handler pointer and a saved word into two fields of a structure reached through the address register, clearing the saved word. It then stores a handler pointer in a control block.

name: initialize_handler_control_block
description: Sets two shared variables to fixed control values, then writes a handler pointer and a saved word into two fields of a structure reached through the address register, clearing the saved word. It then stores a handler pointer in a control block.

name: initialize_handler_control_block
description: Sets two shared variables to fixed control values, then writes a handler pointer and a saved word into two fields of a structure reached through the address register, clearing the saved word. It then stores a handler pointer in a control block.

name: initialize_handler_control_block
description: Sets two shared variables to fixed control values, then writes a handler pointer and a saved word into two fields of a structure reached through the address register, clearing the saved word. It then stores a handler pointer in a control block.

name: initialize_handler_control_block
description: Sets two shared variables to fixed control values, then writes a handler pointer and a saved word into two fields of a structure reached through the address register, clearing the saved word. It then stores a handler pointer in a control block.

name: initialize_timer_and_pointers
description: Writes fixed control constants to shared variables, stores a handler pointer and a shared word into a structure reached through the address register, and clears those shared variables. It then stores a handler pointer in a control block; the recovered facts show it also touches the timer registers.

name: run_audio_script_step
description: Advances a byte-coded audio script by one tick. When its tick counter underflows it reads the next command byte and either starts an audio channel with a sample pointer, length, period and volume, copies table entries, or restarts a channel. A byte that is not a command is kept as a pending value.

name: run_audio_script_resume
description: Resumes the byte-coded audio script on the same tick logic: when the tick counter underflows it reads and executes the next command, which may start an audio channel, copy table entries or restart one. Other bytes are kept as a pending value.

name: run_audio_script_until_pending
description: Loops over byte-coded audio script commands, starting or restarting audio channels and copying table entries, until it reads a byte that is not a script command. It then records that byte as the pending value and returns.

name: continue_audio_script_loop
description: Continues the byte-coded audio script loop from the current stream position, executing commands for audio channels until a non-command byte is read. It then stores the stream position and returns the pending value.

name: restart_audio_script_from_base
description: Restarts the byte-coded audio script loop from a fixed base position, executing commands until a non-command byte is read. It then records that byte as the pending value and returns.

name: store_pending_script_value
description: Subtracts 128 from the data register byte, stores it as the pending value, saves the stream position and advances a counter by four. It writes no channel registers and returns.

name: copy_table_entry_run_script
description: Copies a table entry selected by the next byte into a shared slot, then continues the audio script loop until a non-command byte is read. It then stores the pending value and returns.

name: restart_channel_then_run_script
description: Restarts a channel from a table entry selected by the data register, programming its pointer, length and period, then runs the byte-coded audio script loop until a non-command byte is read. It records that byte as the pending value and returns.

name: run_audio_script_channel_restart
description: Runs the byte-coded audio script loop, starting or restarting a channel from a table entry when a channel command is read. It returns the pending value when a non-command byte appears.

name: run_audio_script_sample_start
description: Runs the byte-coded audio script loop and, whenever a sample command is read, programs an audio channel's pointer, length, period and volume from table entries. It returns the pending value when a non-command byte is reached.

name: store_table_word_run_script
description: Stores a table word into a structure field, merges a second table word into a shared control word, and then runs the byte-coded audio script loop. It returns the pending value when a non-command byte is read.

name: run_audio_script_sample_loop
description: Runs the byte-coded audio script loop, starting a sample on a channel command whose length byte is nonzero and otherwise copying table entries. It returns when a non-command byte is read.

name: set_bit0_pointer_and_width
description: If bit 0 of a flag byte in the object is set, it computes a width from two fields before the sample pointer and stores it at offset 164, stores the pointer plus a field at offset 160, and sets a word at offset 154 to 128. It then always sets a word at offset 156 to 128.

name: set_bit0_handler_and_mask
description: If bit 0 of a flag byte in the object is set, it stores a handler pointer into a shared variable. It then stores 128 at offset 156 of the object.

name: set_mode1_and_masks
description: Stores 1 at offset 150 and 128 at offsets 154 and 156 of the object.

name: set_bit1_pointer_and_width
description: If bit 1 of a flag byte in the object is set, it computes a width from two fields before the sample pointer and stores it at offset 180, stores the pointer plus a field at offset 176, and sets a word at offset 154 to 256. It then always sets a word at offset 156 to 256.

name: set_bit1_handler_and_mask
description: If bit 1 of a flag byte in the object is set, it stores a handler pointer into a shared variable. It then stores 256 at offset 156 of the object.

name: set_mode2_and_masks
description: Stores 2 at offset 150 and 256 at offsets 154 and 156 of the object.

name: set_bit2_pointer_and_width
description: If bit 2 of a flag byte in the object is set, it computes a width from two fields before the sample pointer and stores it at offset 196, stores the pointer plus a field at offset 192, and sets a word at offset 154 to 512. It then always sets a word at offset 156 to 512.

name: set_bit2_handler_and_mask
description: If bit 2 of a flag byte in the object is set, it stores a handler pointer into a shared variable. It then stores 512 at offset 156 of the object.

name: set_mode4_and_masks
description: Stores 4 at offset 150 and 512 at offsets 154 and 156 of the object.

name: decrement_counter_set_bit3_mode
description: If bit 3 of a flag byte in the object is set, it decrements a shared counter and, when the counter becomes negative, stores 8 at offset 150 and 1024 at offset 154. It then always stores 1024 at offset 156.

name: return_without_work

description: Copies a block of 16-byte records from the boot code to a fixed low address, then runs a series of initialization calls, branching on the result of one call. The second branch calls a further routine and then loops forever.

name: init_hardware_or_branch_loop
description: Makes a library call and, when its result is nonzero, runs a sequence of initialization calls and then loops forever clearing a byte. Otherwise it calls a final routine through a pointer and returns. The facts show a DMA control write through the routines it calls.
